title: Murdered. Missing. Survived.
author: Gill Moakes
description:
Murdered, Missing, Survived is a weekly true crime podcast that puts the victims first.

Hosted by Gill Moakes, every episode shares a case from the UK and around the world, in a three-week rotation: a murder, a missing person, and a survivor’s story.

Gill takes on the darkest stories bravely and tells them with care. When she covers a murder, the person who died comes first: their name, their life, and the people who loved them. Missing person episodes share who they are, who is still looking for them, and how you can help bring them home. Survivor episodes honour the people who came through the very worst and lived to tell it.

Meticulously researched, never gratuitous, and fearless about the truth. True crime for listeners who care about the people at the heart of every case: murder cases, missing persons, cold cases, kidnappings and survivor stories.

New episodes every Monday from 4 January 2027. We start with The Ouija Board Jury: the 1993 East Sussex murders of Harry and Nicola Fuller, a British murder trial that went wrong in a way no one could have predicted. Oh... and Gill actually knew the killer...


Follow now on YouTube, Apple Podcasts, Spotify or wherever you like to listen.

Website: murderedmissingsurvived.com

Instagram, TikTok and YouTube: @murderedmissingsurvived


Lives worth remembering and the truth worth fighting for.


Contains descriptions of violent crime. Listener discretion advised.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

description:

title: Real Politik FC
author: El Orden Mundial & Panenka
description:
Real Politik FC es un podcast donde la geopolítica se juega a dos tiempos y el fútbol es mucho más que un deporte: es la clave para entender el mundo. Bajo el lema “Como el fútbol te explica el mundo”, este proyecto une la mirada global de El Orden Mundial y la pasión cultural de Panenka, en una alianza que convierte cada episodio en un auténtico partido de ideas.

En Real Politik FC, todo está conectado: un Mundial en dictadura, una final entre naciones enemigas, o un fichaje que cambia la política regional. En cada episodio, un presentador reparte juego entre dos voces expertas —una de Panenka y otra de El Orden Mundial— para analizar cómo la política internacional se filtra en los estadios, en los vestuarios y hasta en las gradas.

Con un tono cercano, riguroso pero sin corbata, este podcast quiere llegar a todos los públicos: desde los más futboleros hasta los más politizados, pasando por quienes solo buscan entender un poco mejor el mundo a través de las historias que se juegan en la cancha.

El Orden Mundial, referente en análisis internacional en español desde 2012, aporta su red de expertos y su capacidad para desentrañar los grandes temas del presente y la historia global. Panenka, la revista que lleva más de una década hablando de fútbol con profundidad y estilo, suma su enfoque único para contar historias donde el balón y la cultura se encuentran.

Ya está a la venta el nuevo libro de El Orden Mundial: "En la mente de...". Descubre cómo piensan los líderes autoritarios del siglo XXI. Consíguelo en https://amzn.to/4ismTet

Nobody hands you a manual when you become a caregiver. One day you’re a spouse, daughter, son, or friend. The next, you’re juggling appointments, making decisions, advocating for someone you love, and wondering when exactly you became responsible for everything.
Welcome to Caregiver Candor, where we talk about caregiving the way it actually happens. The good, the hard, the complicated, and the stuff nobody warned us about.
Hosted by Judy Davis, caregiver, speaker, and founder of Caregiver Candor, this podcast goes beyond the usual advice to have patience and practice self-care. We’re having honest conversations about the responsibilities nobody explained, the things caregivers rarely say out loud, and what it really takes to navigate care without losing yourself in the process.
Expect real stories, a little humor, uncomfortable truths, and practical strategies you can actually use. From asking better questions and advocating effectively to getting help and finding your footing when life changes overnight, every episode gives you something worth thinking about and one realistic move you can make.
Whether you’re caring for someone, suddenly finding yourself in that role, or working with the families who do, there’s a place for you in this conversation.
No guilt. No apologies. No more ”I’m fine.”
Because the person you’re caring for matters. And so do you.

title: Let's Debate
author: Debates International
description:
In the lead-up to many elections around the world, an important and fragile thing happens: the people asking to lead a government agree to stand on stage and debate each other live, in front of millions of viewers. To viewers, it can look seamless, but that couldn’t be further from the truth. Let's Debate! is about everything it takes to create these vital moments of accountability for democratic leaders worldwide.

Hosted by members of Debates International, the show is a series of conversations with the people who build candidate debates from the ground up, often in countries where no debate has taken place before. Each episode is a case study: how producers create formats to accommodate up to 20+ candidates, how moderators try to hold candidates to the truth in real time, how organizers persuade candidates that the public has the right to hear a candid exchange of views. Taken together, they add up to something larger – an argument, episode by episode, for why this particular ritual still matters.

That argument feels more urgent by the year. Misinformation now travels faster than fact-checking can keep up with, and trust in nearly every institution that once mediated public life is eroding. Against that backdrop, the live, unscripted debate is one of the few remaining moments where voters hear candidates answer for themselves, without a filter. Let's Debate! is for anyone who wants to understand what it takes to protect that – not just debate professionals, but voters, journalists, civic organizers, students, and anyone trying to think seriously about what a healthy democracy still requires.

To go deeper, visit Debates International. New episodes monthly.

description: Elizabeth Interiors is a luxury furniture store in Burlington, Ontario, offering high-quality furniture, timeless design, custom upholstery and interior design services. Visit our furniture showroom for elegant home furniture and personalized guidance from experienced interior designers.

title: Best Of Mosh Codes
author: Nkama Ugochi
description: Best of Mosh Codes brings you practical programming tutorials, software development tips, coding techniques, and insights into modern technologies. Learn, build, and improve your coding skills one episode at a time.

title: A Life You Can Choose: Existentialism with Experts
author: Ethan Ye
description:
Existentialism is the philosophy of our own lives. In each episode, host Ethan Ye invites a scholar to share insights on one existentialist idea in plain language. Three questions guide every conversation: what the idea is, why the philosopher held it, and what it means for us today. The series offers newcomers a clear point of entry and gives experienced readers fresh perspectives. 
Each season covers one existentialist philosopher. Season one begins where it should, with Søren Kierkegaard, widely regarded as the father of existentialism.

title: Fairy Tales, Real Life
author: galina kojanova
description:
What if fairy tales could help us make sense of real life at work?

In Fairy Tales, Real Life, the host - Galina Kojanova - explores leadership, workplace dynamics, human behavior, careers and organizational life through the lens of traditional fairy tales.

Each episode looks beyond the familiar storyline to uncover hidden patterns, challenge assumptions and offer fresh perspectives on situations we may struggle to understand in our professional lives.

Because sometimes, the story we need to understand isn't the fairy tale. It's the one we're living.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: The Pod with Trellis Collaborative
author: Tara Good
description: Candid conversations about how the wine industry really works. Host Tara Good sits down with winery owners, winemakers, marketers and industry leaders to dig into the hard mechanics of hospitality, marketing and management: what’s working, what’s failing, and what the numbers are actually saying.

title: What's Your Kryptonite? with Dan Ruimy
author: Dan Ruimy
description:
What's holding you back?
Join Dan Ruimy—author, entrepreneur, former Member of Parliament, and Mayor—for honest conversations about leadership, resilience, self-doubt, and life's unexpected challenges.
Through personal stories, real-world experiences, and conversations with fascinating guests, we explore the obstacles that shape us and the choices that move us forward.
Inspired by his book What's Your Kryptonite?, this podcast is about discovering your strengths, confronting your challenges, and finding your way forward.

title: The Business of Being You
author: Em Roberts
description: This corner of the internet we build a business as yourself. Somatic mentor Em unpacks visibility fears, “I know what to do, so why aren’t I doing it?” spirals, and the moment the woman who built the business isn’t the one who’ll grow it. New episodes Thursday. Follow to hear episode one first!

title: The Honky Tonk Time Machine With Glen Johnson
author: honkytonktimemachine
description: Glen has been interviewing the country stars he grew up admiring since the show began in 2020. Some of the biggest names of 80's and 90's country join him to tell the stories behind their biggest hits, talk influences, tell stories from the road and more. Catch the full show Saturday Nights at 8 PM on Clear 94. (KKLR Poplar Bluff) This is your source for the full conversations with the stars!

title: Some Assembly Required
author: Shadowlight Creative Studios
description:
Welcome to Some Assembly Required!

The world of Gundam is coming to the tabletop, and we're here for all of it.

Join Nate, Dev, and Justin as we dive into Gundam Assemble, exploring everything from building and painting your favorite mobile suits to gameplay, strategy, lore, and the ever growing Gundam universe.

Whether you're a lifelong Gundam fan, a tabletop gaming veteran, or just discovering the hobby, there's a place for you in the hangar.

Expect plenty of opinions, friendly arguments, hobby talk, and probably a few questionable tactical decisions.

Suit up, power on, and get ready. Some Assembly Required is just getting started.

Subscribe now and join us for the journey!

Produced by Shadowlight Creative Studios.

Intro and outro music by Phoenix Ash.

title: Secrets of Divine Love Podcast
author: A. Helwa
description:
For anyone who has ever loved God and still felt far away.
Each episode, A. Helwa, author of Secrets of Divine Love, sits with a beloved teacher, scholar or seeker to ask the questions we usually only ask in prayer: How do we keep our hearts open after they’ve been broken? What does it mean to be truly loved by God, not just obey Him?
These are not interviews about spiritual lives, but conversations from inside them, exploring Sufism, Rumi, the Qur’an, the sacred feminine, prayer, grief and the mystery of divine love.
So come as you are and know you will always be welcome here.

title: The Simplified Scholar
author: Dr Brian Fernandes
description: The Simplified Scholar is a podcast that turns big ideas into simple, meaningful conversations. Hosted by Dr Brian Fernandes, Physicist and Educator, the podcast explores powerful ideas from books, science, psychology, philosophy, personal development, and everyday life : without the jargon or complexity. This podcast is for curious minds, lifelong learners, students, educators, professionals, and anyone who wants to learn something valuable without feeling overwhelmed. Great ideas should not remain trapped in complicated books or academic language. Each episode simplifies important concepts, extracts the key lessons, and connects them to real life, helping you think better and live wiser. 🎙️ The Simplified Scholar — Big Ideas. Made Simple. To know more about Dr Brian Fernandes, visit www.catchbrian.com.

title: Athlete Blueprint Podcast

Hosted by Moreen Miiro Arinaitwe where we dive into the sport world to share experience, expertise, inspiration, practical knowledge all to develop complete athletes-from potential to performance.

title: Code Win
author: Kagiso D
description:
Welcome back to Code Win—the podcast where technology meets ambition, and smart strategies crack the code to business success. I’m your host, [Your Name], and I’m thrilled to have you here today.
Whether you’re building your very first startup from a garage, scaling a growing enterprise, or looking for that next breakthrough idea, this is your space to decode what it really takes to win in today’s fast-moving business world.
Every week, we sit down with founders, innovators, and industry leaders to unpack their journeys—the real stories, the hard-fought lessons, and the actionable strategies you can apply to your own venture right away.
So grab your notebook, sharpen your focus, and get ready to elevate your game. This is Code Win. Let’s get started!

title: Insane Missions
author: Gumball
description: Ever wondered what happens when someone decides to push the limits of the impossible just to see what happens? Welcome to Insane Missions — the podcast where extreme curiosity meets reality. Here, we dive deep behind the scenes of the wildest projects, unbelievable stories of overcoming the odds, game-changing ideas, and the most absurd moments from the digital world and business. Forget the basics: buckle up, because every episode is a high-octane ride into the extraordinary. Hit play and find out just how far human imagination can go!

author: Summer House Institute
description: The Power of Exposure is a podcast brought to you by the Summer House Institute. This podcast series documents the cohort of the Summer House Institute includes individual reflections from each member of the inaugural cohort of the Summer House Institute. The series will highlight the inner workings of SHI and also the experiences and reflections of each member as they are exposed to opportunities within public education.Check out these episodes and learn about the experiences of these Black males as they reflect on their summer learning about the inner-workings of public education in America.

Welcome to Everyday Grooves, the podcast that skips the hustle culture and focuses on success just by living in harmony with nature.
Hosted by Shake, each episode drops quick, actionable "grooves” aka lifestyle beats that you can effortlessly slide into each day.
Whether you’re on your commute, making breakfast, or hitting the gym, tune in to find your rhythm, build better routines, and move to a healthier frequency.
Hit follow or subscribe to catch our latest grooves.

Welcome to Breath. Be. Begin. a podcast exploring what it means to live well, find connection and navigate the many seasons of life.

title: Bad Housekeeping
author: Bad Housekeeping
description:
This is Bad Housekeeping: the podcast that explores the life and work of Shirley Jackson, master of mid-century domestic horror. Join us, Dr. Kasia Van Schaik and Miriam Richer, as we investigate stories of unsettled and unsettling domesticity. Each episode will dip into Shirley Jackson’s archive to parse what we’re calling “Bad Housekeeping”: the feminist impulse to question the happy housewife, abandon the dishes in the sink, and ask: what if women stopped trying to keep it all together? What if we could do domesticity differently? 
For lovers of domestic horror and keepers of messy homes.

Throughout this podcast, I will discuss various topics, including how you can use your major to serve Christ, the spiritual life of Cedarville students, the lessons God has taught me and my friends, and various aspects of theology and ministry.

description: Two cousins, Sam and Luke Bradford, talking Alabama men's basketball after every game. We're Bama fans, but we won't pump sunshine. When the Tide gets outrebounded by a team it's three inches taller than, or the freshmen keep turning it over, we'll say so. title: dys-FUNCTIONAL Podcast™
author: Haley James
description:
COMING FALL 2025 📆🎉
Welcome to the dys-FUNCTIONAL podcast, where we discuss ways to function with Dysautonomia! 

Dysautonomia is an umbrella term for a bunch of different conditions that all cause your automatic body functions such as breathing, heart rate, blood pressure, digestion and so on to not work correctly. 

Here, we bring doctors, practitioners, caregivers, autonomic experts, and Dysautonomia warriors to the mic to discuss tips, strategies, the latest research, treatments, real-life stories and answers to your questions to help you on your Dysautonomia journey. 

With host Haley James, a full-time chronic illness patient who has spent the last few years navigating life with multiple types of Dysautonomia, we find answers, community, laughs and ways to find joy amidst the struggle. 

Whether you have POTS, AAG, FD, MSA or any one of the numerous types of dysautonomia, this podcast is for you as we explore ways to navigate, function and thrive with Dysautonomia!

I’m Elizabeth, a licensed professional counselor and yoga teacher with six years of teaching experience. Here, you’ll find guided meditations, yoga nidra, body scans, and soothing sleep stories to support rest and reflection. My approach brings together an understanding of emotional well-being and a love for gentle, restorative practices. Get comfortable, take a breath, and melt into your space.

description:
The Elite Edge Podcast stars coach Chris McCarthy & coach Larry Barretta, hosted by Franky. 
The boys will talk about their background, how Elite Edge got started, where the rink is at now and what the future holds. They will be joined by coaches from Elite Edge, players who train there, as well as other special guests.

title: The Weekly Watchlist
author: The Weekly Watchlist
description:
Never waste another evening scrolling through Netflix again! Welcome to The Weekly Watchlist — your ultimate guide to the best movies, TV shows, and hidden streaming gems.
Wondering what's actually worth watching this weekend? Every week, we break down mandatory blockbusters, trending series, plot twists, spoiler-free reviews, and upcoming release dates across Netflix, Amazon Prime, HBO, Disney+, and Apple TV+.
What you'll get in every episode:
🍿 Weekend Recommendations: Handpicked movies and TV shows to binge-watch without wasting time.
🎬 Unfiltered Reviews: Honest breakdowns, ratings, and plot highlights of the newest releases.
🍿 Hidden Gems: Underrated thrillers, comedies, and dramas you probably missed on your watchlist.
Stop searching and start watching — hit FOLLOW or SUBSCRIBE now to upgrade your movie nights!

title: What's Understated
author: Anthony Ghie
description: Life’s lessons are often unsaid. They are buried many layers deep in consciousness, yet they prove to be what matters most. Hosted by Anthony Ghie, this podcast uncovers them to finally reveal “What’s Under Stated.”

title: Muscle, Mustache, Mindfull
author: Literature and Society
description:
💪 Welcome to Muscle, Mustache, Mindfull!
Where fitness meets strength, humor, and a healthy mindset!This podcast explores the world of fitness, bodybuilding, strength training, muscle building, nutrition, workout routines, and mental well-being. We believe that building a better body is not just about lifting heavier weights or achieving the perfect physique. It's also about developing discipline, confidence, and a stronger mind.From gym tips and fitness trends to healthy lifestyles, recovery techniques, and motivational conversations, we bring you insights and inspiration to make your fitness journey more enjoyable.Whether you're a beginner, a dedicated gym enthusiast, or simply someone looking to live a healthier life, there's always something new to learn and improve.🏋️ Build Your Muscle. Grow Your Mind. Keep Your Mustache.🔥 Muscle, Mustache, Mindfull — Stronger Bodies, Sharper Minds, Better Lives!

title: Identity in Motion
author: MIYA Design Studio
description:
In an era shaped by video and quick decisions about what to watch, every brand moves, whether it means to or not. A logo resolves, an interface responds, a campaign pauses before it speaks. Identity in Motion looks at those choices and asks what they say about who a brand is.
Each episode explores how movement, rhythm, and behavior build recognition over time—connecting brand strategy to the motion design decisions that shape what people notice, feel, and remember.
For designers, strategists, and curious thinkers who want to understand how brands communicate through motion.

title: Backline & Bar Tabs
author: R5 Media Co.
description:
The stories behind the stage. The conversations after last call.
Welcome to Backline, where the music industry meets the barstool. Hosted by Karissa and Jenna, we're pulling back the curtain on the artists, venues, industry insiders, and personalities who make the music scene what it is.
From backstage stories and career highs to industry hot takes and conversations that probably should've stayed off the record, nothing's too polished and very little is off-limits.
We're here for the stories you don't hear on stage, the people behind the music, and a little chaos along the way.
No scripts.

title: Reality Rewritten
author: Koyshon Blake
description:
What if you never needed sleep? What if money disappeared overnight? What if animals could finally tell us what they’re thinking?
Welcome to Reality Rewritten, hosted by Koyshon Blake—a podcast where one question opens the door to a different world.
Each episode changes one rule of everyday reality and follows the consequences, from unexpected opportunities to problems nobody saw coming. Through vivid storytelling, scientific ideas, and thoughtful speculation, we explore how life, relationships, and society might unfold under entirely different rules.
Some possibilities are funny. Others are unsettling. Every question offers a fresh way to see the world we already live in.
One Question. A Different World.
AI-assisted production.

description: The Service Physics Podcast breaks down what actually makes service businesses run, the systems, operations, and human behavior behind great customer experiences. Each episode digs into how restaurants, retailers, and hospitality teams design better operations, train their people, and turn everyday service into a competitive edge. Conversations with operators, founders, and frontline experts who've done the work. If you build, run, or care about service at scale, this one's for you.

title: Five Nations Rising Podcast
author: North Dakota Indian Affairs Commission
description:
Five Nations Rising is a podcast presented by the North Dakota Indian Affairs Commission, dedicated to sharing the voices, stories, and perspectives of the five Tribal Nations of North Dakota: the Mandan, Hidatsa, and Arikara Nation, Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa Indians, Standing Rock Sioux Tribe, Spirit Lake Tribe, and Sisseton Wahpeton Oyate.
Through conversations with Tribal leaders, educators, entrepreneurs, and community members, we highlight Native culture, leadership, history, and the people making a difference in their communities.

title: Hobby Explorer: AI, Tech and Startups

description:
Hobby Explorer is an AI and technology podcast from San Francisco hosted by Magesh Vadivelu, a former Amazon, Salesforce and Nextdoor engineer, TEDx speaker and founder who grew his YouTube channel to over 1 million subscribers. Episodes cover AI tools, tech news, startups and building in public, plus live Founders Debates where two founders argue opposite sides of one motion.
For founders, builders and tech professionals who want to think clearly about the AI era.

title: The Becoming Podcast
author: Dominique Bostic
description:
Honest conversations. Intentional growth. A life rooted in Christ.
Hosted by Dominique Bostic, The Becoming Podcast is a Christ-centered space for women navigating faith, identity, purpose, relationships, and personal growth.
Through honest conversations, meaningful reflections, and diverse perspectives, we explore what it means to embrace life's transitions, grow in faith, and become who God is calling us to be.
You don't have to have it all figured out to belong at the table.
Pull up a chair. There's room for you here.

title: Larger

description: What we build, and the future we're walking into. Singapore needs a serious record of how things get built here. Larger brings light to what is being built and asks how it may shape the way we live, work and relate to one another as we walk into an uncertain future. Each guest leaves one idea for the next generation of builders. Hosted by Isaac Ho.

title: Marketing Agency CFO
author: Bender CFO Services
description:
Real stories from marketing agency owners, plus the financial clarity to make better decisions.
On the Marketing Agency CFO Podcast, host Shane Bender, CPA, sits down with agency leaders to talk about how they built their businesses, the hard calls they’ve made, and what they wish they’d known sooner. You’ll hear honest conversations about growth, hiring, pricing, cash flow, and the lessons that come from owning a business, the wins and the mistakes.
Shane is the founder of Bender CFO Services, a fractional CFO firm that helps growing agencies improve cash flow, plan ahead, and navigate a changing marketplace. In each episode, he brings a CFO’s view to the conversation and keeps the finance talk simple and practical.
Some episodes feature a guest, and others are solo episodes where Shane shares ideas you can put to work right away. Most run about 20 minutes, so you can listen on a short drive or between meetings.
Made for marketing agency owners and anyone who hires agencies and wants to hear how great ones are run.

title: Money in Mind

Where does your money go—and how can you give it a clearer purpose?
Welcome to Money in Mind, hosted by Jacob Ivan. Through relatable stories, practical examples, and clear explanations, we explore everyday money management—from budgeting and saving to understanding investments, risk, and the habits behind financial decisions.
Whether you’re managing your first paycheck or planning for the years ahead, join Jacob to make sense of financial concepts, understand the trade-offs, and build a more thoughtful relationship with money.
Understand Your Money. Shape Your Future.
For educational purposes only. This podcast does not provide personalized financial or investment advice.

title: Learn Chinês Basic

description:
​Welcome to LEARN CHINÊS BASIC — your ultimate guide to mastering Mandarin Chinese from the ground up! 
​Whether you are an absolute beginner starting from zero, planning a trip to China, or simply fascinated by the language and culture, this channel makes learning Mandarin simple, engaging, and accessible.
​We break down complex characters, tones, and grammar rules into bite-sized, easy-to-understand lessons. From essential daily vocabulary and Pinyin to practical conversational phrases, we provide everything you need to build a strong foundation.

title: 5-Minute News
author: 5-Minute News
description:
5-Minute News is your daily news briefing, built for people who want to stay informed without spending an hour doing it.
Every episode delivers the day's most important stories in about five minutes. We cover the top headline, a quick rundown of what else is making news, and one story explained in a little more depth, so you understand not just what happened but why it matters. We close each episode with one thing to watch tomorrow.
There's no filler, no shouting, and no endless commentary. Just clear, accurate, plain-language reporting you can listen to on your commute, while making coffee, at the gym, or between meetings.
What you'll get in every episode:
The top story of the day
Three to four quick headlines
One story explained in context
What to watch next
Who it's for:
Busy professionals who want to be informed before the workday starts
Commuters and anyone with a few spare minutes
Anyone tired of news overload who wants a calm, efficient daily update
New episodes every weekday. Subscribe, and be caught up in five minutes.

title: Lerning French

description:
Welcome to Learn French. — your ultimate destination for mastering the French language! 
​Whether you are starting from absolute zero, planning a trip to Paris, or looking to refine your grammar and pronunciation, this channel is designed to help you speak French with confidence.
​Here, learning a new language is engaging, practical, and fun. We break down complex grammar rules, explore essential everyday vocabulary, dive into native slang, and share cultural insights that textbooks often miss.

title: Weekly Real Estate Q&A with Dr. Veleta Eaton

Each episode answers real questions from buyers, sellers, and homeowners and breaks down topics like credit, affordability, renting vs. buying, preparing to purchase, and understanding the real estate process. description: Patty Mulloy grew up as one of the only brown people she knew. As an Indian international adoptee raised in the deep South she wondered: if adoption is supposed to be a story of love and belonging, why did she feel so out of place? When Patty started speaking with other adoptees, she realized she wasn’t alone. But what began as a simple curiosity, opens up a bigger investigation than she ever imagined. Accusations of human trafficking, accounts of forged documents, and the boom-and-bust of a multi-million-dollar global business leave Patty grappling with her own adoption. Through nine episodes, Patty’s intimate conversations with adoptees reveal the emotional consequences of being moved across oceans. Part-memoir, part-investigation, this series will make you question the story you’ve been told about adoption – because the story doesn’t end when a child finds a home.

क्या भगवान तक पहुँचना ही सबसे बड़ी भक्ति है, या भगवान में ही विलीन हो जाना सच्ची भक्ति है? 🙏

सतगुरु रविदास जी फरमाते हैं—

"तोही मोही, मोही तोही, अंतरू कैसा।
कनक कटिक, जल तरंग जैसा।"

जैसे सोने और उससे बने कंगन में कोई भेद नहीं होता, जैसे लहर और जल एक ही हैं, वैसे ही सच्ची भक्ति में भक्त और प्रभु के बीच कोई भेद नहीं रह जाता।

संत नामदेव जी कहते हैं—
"नामे नाराइन नाही भेद।"

संत कबीर जी फरमाते हैं—
"राम कबीरा एक भए हैं।"

✨ सच्ची भक्ति केवल भगवान को पाने का नाम नहीं, बल्कि अपने अहंकार को मिटाकर प्रभु के प्रेम में लीन हो जाने का मार्ग है।

🙏 नाम-सिमरन से मिटता है 'मैं', प्रकट होता है 'वह'।

अगर यह आध्यात्मिक संदेश आपके हृदय को शांति और प्रेरणा दे, तो इसे अपने परिवार और मित्रों के साथ जरूर शेयर करें।

title: The Art of Being Her
author: Maria Nielsen
description:
What if the life you want isn't about changing everything around you, but about becoming the woman who knows how to create it?


Welcome to The Art of Being Her, the podcast for women who are ready to stop waiting for life, relationships, and circumstances to change fore they can finally feel happy, peaceful and fulfilled.


I'm Maria Nielsen, a life coach who believe that understanding emotions is one of the most powerful skills you can develop.


Through personal stories, relatable experiences, humor, and powerful insights, humor, and powerful insights, we'll explore how your emotions influence the way you show up in your marriage, relationships, career, and everyday life. 


We'll talk about people pleasing, loving boundaries, resentment, expectations, communications, overthinking and all the ways we unintentionally get in our own way. 


It's about discovering the woman you're capable of being when you stop allowing fear, guilt, anxiety, and other peoples' behavior determine how you experience your life. 


Knowing what to do and actually being the woman who does it are two very different things. 


The art isn't in creating the perfect life, it's in becoming the woman who knows how to live fully, even when life isn't perfect. Let's discover her together.

Your health determines the quality of your life. It’s time to reclaim it and take your energy to the next level! Subscribe now and begin your journey toward a stronger, more energized, more resilient you.

title: REAL LIFE WITH LAN
author: REAL LIFE WITH LAN
description:
Real life. Real lessons. Real rebuilding.

Welcome to Real Life With Lan — the podcast about what happens when life doesn’t go according to plan…and you decide to build what’s next anyway.

I’m Lani, aka Lan — a wife, mom of three, entrepreneur and woman rebuilding from the inside out.

After 20+ years in business, sales, leadership, real estate, speaking, training and entrepreneurship, I’ve experienced wins, losses, pivots and plenty of lessons learned the hard way.

Now I’m navigating a new chapter: deepening my relationship with God, rebuilding my health, finding myself again, changing my relationship with money, raising my family and learning how to turn decades of experience into opportunities in today’s digital world.

We’ll talk faith, health, healing, marriage, motherhood, money, business, personal growth, food, family and the beautiful chaos in between.

I’m not here because I have life figured out.

I’m letting you watch me build what’s next.

If you’re rebuilding too, pull up a chair. You belong here.

Starting over doesn’t mean starting from zero.

On Just Show Up, host Christian Thompson talks with friends, family, and people whose big stories started small about what they almost didn't start, what their first small step looked like, and what showing up looks like on a bad day. Show up. Start small. Keep going. New episodes every other week.

title: Keeping Up With Reality

title: Synapse & Cognition

description:
Synapse & Cognition explores how the brain and mind shape the way we think, feel and behave. Each episode takes a question we rarely stop to ask, like "Why do we say men don't cry?", and looks at it through psychology and neuroscience, drawing on research, real studies and conversations with students, researchers and academics.
From emotion and memory to sleep and the teenage brain, the show asks what the evidence says, where it's still debated, and what it means for everyday life. No jargon without explanation, and no claims without evidence.
Hosted by Aima Aamir. New episodes are released regularly.

Hosted by Sivaraman Swaminathan (Swami), the Super CMO Show explores the ideas, decisions, and practices shaping marketing. Through in-depth conversations with marketing leaders, academics, authors, and entrepreneurs, the show uncovers how businesses understand customers, build brands, and drive growth.

From consumer behaviour and brand strategy to marketing technology, data, AI, and emerging trends, each episode connects fresh thinking with practical experience. We explore the why behind marketing decisions, the mental models guiding successful marketers, and the lessons our guests have learned along the way.

Whether you are a seasoned marketing leader, an entrepreneur building your business, or a student beginning your career, these conversations will challenge your assumptions, broaden your perspective, and help you become a more thoughtful and effective marketer.

"Rise with Veronik'A"
Life is not only about success, perfect choices, and easy transformations. It is also made of fear, doubt, loss, illness, disability, loneliness, failure, grief, relationships, ambition, courage, unexpected detours, and sometimes moments when simply moving forward already feels difficult.
"Rise with Veronik'A" is a podcast about all of it.
Through honest reflections, real stories, meaningful conversations, and practical tools, Veronik'A explores the experiences that shape the way we think, feel, love, choose, and live.
We will talk about self-confidence, self-esteem, the power of words, relationships, resilience, memory, ambition, and personal growth.
But we will also make space for conversations that are still too often avoided: mental health, illness, disability, grief, exclusion, vulnerability, and those life experiences that can change everything.
Not to offer ready-made answers.  
Not to pretend that every difficulty can be solved through positive thinking.
But to understand more deeply, question what we have been taught, listen differently, and discover what can truly help us move forward.
Some episodes will inspire you. Others will challenge you. And some may simply make you feel understood.
Because rising does not always mean becoming stronger.
Sometimes, it means accepting.  
Sometimes, rebuilding.  
Sometimes, changing direction.  
And sometimes, simply finding the courage to take the next step.
Think differently. Rise stronger. Live fully.
